case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO.684 OF 2021; CIVIL APPEAL NO.6927 OF 2021

parties.petitioner: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited

summary: Coal supply shortfall under PPAs; Change in Law provisions under Electricity Act, 2003 s.63; NCDP 2007 and NCDP 2013 framework; compensatory fuel charge mechanism; pass-through of imported/market coal costs; APTEL remand; MERC tariff decisions; Heat Rate and Gross Calorific Value standards; relief limited to minimum supply obligations per NCDP 2013.
legal_provisions_cited: Energy Watchdog v. Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (2017) 14 SCC 80
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; MERC orders set aside for reconsideration per NCDP 2013 framework and revised tariff policy.
